        else:

        crime_df.loc[crime_df['borough'] == missing_borough, 'value'] = mean_val

neighbor_weights = [weights[i, idxs] for i, idxs in enumerate(neighbor_indices)]

    adj_dict = {b: [] for b in all_boroughs}
    for _, row in adj_df.iterrows():
        b = row['borough']
        n = row['neighbor']
        if b in all_boroughs and n in all_boroughs:
            adj_dict[b].append(n)
            adj_dict[n].append(b)
    missing_row = crime_df[crime_df['value'].isna()]
    missing_borough = missing_row['borough'].iloc[0]
    neighbors = adj_dict[missing_borough]
    if neighbors:
        neighbor_crimes = crime_df[crime_df['borough'].isin(neighbors)]['value'].dropna()
        impute_value = neighbor_crimes.mean()
    else:
        impute_value = crime_df['value'].dropna().mean()
    crime_df.loc[crime_df['borough'] == missing_borough, 'value'] = impute_value

            W[i, j] = 1
np.fill_diagonal(W, 0)
row_sums = W.sum(axis=1)
row_sums[row_sums == 0] = 1
